Now, although the historians’ accounts differ, could it be that Bao, because his predecessors had not undertaken this work, did not know what could be accomplished? Or did Bao begin it but leave it unfinished, and Qi then complete it through further dredging and excavation? Later, it was Cui Yuan, Magistrate of Ji County, who opened several hundred qing of rice paddies and, during seven years in office, spread good government and moral transformation so widely that people sang, “Heaven has sent down an enlightened lord.” It was Shao Xinchen and Du Shi, Governors of Nanyang, who gave rise to the popular saying “Father Shao and Mother Du”: the former cleared channels and built sluice gates, irrigating as much as thirty thousand qing annually; his successor further repaired reservoirs and ponds and expanded the cultivated land. Was it not General-in-Chief Du Yu who diverted the waters of the Zhi, Yu, and other rivers to irrigate more than ten thousand qing of fields on the plains, marked boundaries with inscribed stones, and thereby benefited the common people? And was it not Xiahou Mao [?], Regional Inspector of Yuzhou, who commanded troops at Cangling, built weirs to irrigate more than a thousand qing, and harvested over a million shi of grain annually to replenish reserves and also support the poor? These men either surveyed the elevation of the land and channeled water accordingly, or traced existing works and repaired and dredged them. All thereby brought wealth and strength to their own times and left an honored reputation to posterity. Could we not adopt their methods as our models?
During the Taiding reign of the Yuan dynasty, Academician Yu Ji proposed using the methods of the people of Zhejiang to build embankments against the water and irrigate coastal fields east of the capital. His methods were assuredly practicable, yet idle talk ultimately obstructed them. By the Zhizheng reign, grain shipments by sea failed to arrive, and the capital lacked food. The chief ministers recalled Ji’s …

title: 隆慶四年河南鄉試錄
text:
之言于是乎有海口萬戶之設雖以紓一
時之急然幾會已失事勢已去不可爲矣
嗚呼豈非後世之永鑒哉先正丘文莊謂
當如集之策起取閩浙知田事者講究而
行之內以實
京師外以實邊儲且推極以爲治國平天下
之要道不出於此信矣其在於今
國計乏而民生困以故
當亡經營中外之條議至出一切權宜無餘
似矣是病已七年矣而三年之艾不及今
蓄之可乎愚甞反覆思畫水田之利非但
藉以足國亦民之自厚厥生者顧常人安
於故俗小民難於慮始每聞開田之議猶
有倡爲阻撓之說者其施爲措置之方要
在招徠而鼓舞之以漸而不驟耳是故其
務有五曰始近水之地也曰先有力之家
也曰任督率之官也曰募教習之人也曰
布鼓勵之令也夫田宜灌溉以時而因水
punctuated:
之言，於是乎有海口萬戶之設。雖以紓一時之急，然幾會已失，事勢已去，不可爲矣。嗚呼！豈非後世之永鑒哉？先正丘文莊謂當如集之策，起取閩浙知田事者，講究而行之，內以實京師，外以實邊儲，且推極以爲治國平天下之要道不出於此，信矣。
其在於今，國計乏而民生困，以故當亡經營，中外之條議，至出一切權宜，無餘似矣。是病已七年矣，而三年之艾不及今蓄之，可乎？愚甞反覆思畫，水田之利，非但藉以足國，亦民之自厚厥生者。顧常人安於故俗，小民難於慮始，每聞開田之議，猶有倡爲阻撓之說者。其施爲措置之方，要在招徠而鼓舞之，以漸而不驟耳。是故其務有五：曰始近水之地也，曰先有力之家也，曰任督率之官也，曰募教習之人也，曰布鼓勵之令也。夫田宜灌溉以時，而因水
translation_en:
…his words, and thus the Haikou Myriarchy was established. Although this relieved the immediate emergency, the opportunity had already been lost and favorable circumstances had passed; nothing more could be accomplished. Alas! Is this not an enduring warning for later generations? The late worthy Qiu Wenzhuang said that Yu Ji’s proposal should be followed: men from Fujian and Zhejiang knowledgeable about farming should be recruited to examine it thoroughly and put it into practice, thereby replenishing supplies at the capital within and the frontier granaries without. He further maintained that, pursued to its fullest extent, the essential way to govern the state and bring peace to all under Heaven lay in this. How true!
At present, state finances are depleted and the people’s livelihoods are strained. Consequently, those responsible have undertaken measures [?], while proposals from officials at court and in the provinces have extended to every possible expedient; it seems nothing remains untried. This illness has already lasted seven years: can we fail to begin now to store the mugwort that must be aged for three years? I have repeatedly reflected and planned: the benefits of irrigated fields lie not merely in supplying the state, but also in enabling the people themselves to enrich their livelihoods. Yet ordinary people are content with established customs, and the common people find it difficult to consider a venture at its inception. Whenever proposals to open fields are heard, there are still those who advance arguments to obstruct them. The essential method of implementation and management is to attract people and encourage them, proceeding gradually rather than abruptly. Thus there are five tasks: begin with land near water; give precedence to households with adequate resources; appoint officials to supervise and direct the work; recruit people to provide instruction; and issue orders offering encouragement. Fields should be irrigated at the proper times, and by taking advantage of water …

title: 隆慶四年河南鄉試錄
text:
之便尤易爲力必擇於溝瀆湖蕩之間以
導以激焉庶不苦難易止而濬塘鑿池可
漸次舉矣故曰地之近水者始焉開溝塍
備桔槔既勞且費非無力者可任也必酌
其力而計畝限之一歲有獲則利之所在
即貧者趨之莫禦矣故曰家之有力者先
焉古有勸農之官今水田始興必於州縣
佐貳中遴委南人知水利者專任其事其
鄰封無官之處併屬之俾往來循行率作
===
興事考厥成功而優敘之故曰督率之官
所當任焉漬種挿秧備器具測泥塗俱有
節度惟南人習之必多方招致厚其廩餼
或授閑田俾耕以自食諸凡事宜咸聽指
畫仍繪圖刻書昭示久遠故曰教習之人
所當募焉勸而後興民情也試移檄諸郡
邑曰地可塘可池可佈田而業主無力者
官量處給牛種或以贖鍰佐其工費凡開
田之家照畝免差三年田成而後役之人
punctuated: 之便，尤易爲力。必擇於溝瀆湖蕩之間，以導以激焉，庶不苦難易止，而濬塘鑿池可漸次舉矣。故曰：地之近水者始焉。開溝塍，備桔槔，既勞且費，非無力者可任也。必酌其力而計畝限之，一歲有獲，則利之所在，即貧者趨之莫禦矣。故曰：家之有力者先焉。古有勸農之官，今水田始興，必於州縣佐貳中遴委南人知水利者，專任其事。其鄰封無官之處，併屬之，俾往來循行，率作興事，考厥成功而優敘之。故曰：督率之官所當任焉。漬種挿秧，備器具，測泥塗，俱有節度，惟南人習之。必多方招致，厚其廩餼，或授閑田，俾耕以自食。諸凡事宜，咸聽指畫，仍繪圖刻書，昭示久遠。故曰：教習之人所當募焉。勸而後興，民情也。試移檄諸郡邑曰：「地可塘可池可佈田，而業主無力者，官量處給牛種，或以贖鍰佐其工費。凡開田之家，照畝免差三年，田成而後役之。」人
translation_en: …the convenience of access to water makes the work especially easy. Sites must be chosen among channels, lakes, and marshes, where water can be led and raised, so that difficulties will not cause people readily to abandon the undertaking [?]. Dredging ponds and digging reservoirs can then proceed by stages. Hence the injunction: begin with land close to water. Digging channels and making field embankments, and providing well sweeps, require both labor and expenditure; those without resources cannot undertake them. Each household’s resources must be assessed and a limit set on the acreage accordingly. Once a year’s harvest has been obtained and the profits are apparent, even the poor will flock to the undertaking, and nothing will hold them back. Hence the injunction: give priority to households with resources. In antiquity there were officials charged with encouraging agriculture. Now, as wet-field cultivation is first being developed, southerners knowledgeable about water management must be selected from among the assistant officials of departments and counties and given sole responsibility for this work. Neighboring jurisdictions without such officials should also be placed under their charge. Have them travel back and forth inspecting, directing cultivation, and initiating the work; assess their accomplishments and grant them preferential advancement. Hence the injunction: appoint officials to supervise and direct the work. Soaking seed, transplanting seedlings, preparing implements, and gauging the mud all require proper procedures, with which only southerners are familiar. Every means must be used to recruit them, providing generous grain allowances or granting them idle land to cultivate for their own support. In all practical matters, follow their guidance. Illustrations should also be drawn and books printed to make these methods clear for generations to come. Hence the injunction: recruit people to teach the methods. It is human nature to act only after encouragement. Let an official directive be sent to the prefectures and counties, stating: “Where land is suitable for ponds, reservoirs, or laying out fields, but the owners lack resources, the authorities shall make appropriate provision for supplying oxen and seed, or use redemption fines to help meet the costs of the work. All households opening fields shall be exempted from service obligations for three years in proportion to the acreage; only after the fields are established shall service be required of them.” People …

title: 隆慶四年河南鄉試錄
text:
將爭相墾種水利大興故曰鼓勸之令所
當布焉五事既盡則數歲之後稼穡成功
不惟田畝多收而賦稅易辦不惟常歲可
飽而凶荒有備由是而寬東南之民由是
而阜西北之財將焉往而不利哉雖然此
尤守令之責耳蓋守令最爲親民利澤易
於及下凡夫因天時而相地勢各悉其區
畫之方宜土俗而合人情不失乎潤澤之
善斯水利之興有攸賴矣是故有召杜而
===
後可以成陂池之功有西史而後可以底
漳水之績固其徵也此又在監司一加之
意焉相與責成之以期後效愚生何足以
與此
punctuated: 將爭相墾種，水利大興，故曰鼓勸之令所當布焉。五事既盡，則數歲之後，稼穡成功，不惟田畝多收而賦稅易辦，不惟常歲可飽而凶荒有備。由是而寬東南之民，由是而阜西北之財，將焉往而不利哉？雖然，此尤守令之責耳。蓋守令最爲親民，利澤易於及下。凡夫因天時而相地勢，各悉其區畫之方；宜土俗而合人情，不失乎潤澤之善，斯水利之興有攸賴矣。是故有召杜而後可以成陂池之功，有西史而後可以底漳水之績，固其徵也。此又在監司一加之意焉，相與責成之，以期後效。愚生何足以與此？
translation_en:
…people will compete to reclaim and cultivate the land, and irrigation will flourish. Thus I say that orders encouraging these efforts should be promulgated. Once all five measures have been fully implemented, within a few years cultivation will yield results: not only will the fields produce larger harvests and taxes become easier to pay, but there will also be enough food in ordinary years and reserves against famine. In this way the burdens of the people of the southeast will be eased, and the wealth of the northwest increased. Wherever these measures are applied, how could they fail to bring benefits?

Nevertheless, this is above all the responsibility of prefects and magistrates. They are the officials closest to the people, and their beneficence can readily reach those below. By working with the seasons and examining the terrain, each should thoroughly understand how to plan for his jurisdiction; by accommodating local customs and human sentiments, they should ensure that benefits are appropriately distributed. The development of irrigation will then have something on which to depend. Thus it takes men such as Shao Xinchen and Du Shi to accomplish the construction of reservoirs and ponds, and men such as Ximen Bao and Shi Qi to achieve results with the waters of the Zhang River. These examples certainly bear this out.

It further rests with the surveillance commissioners to give this matter their attention and jointly hold the responsible officials accountable for its accomplishment, in expectation of results to come. How could an unworthy student such as I be qualified to take part in this?

title: 隆慶四年河南鄉試錄
text:
河南鄉試錄後序
隆慶庚午秋八月河南鄉試
事竣其以叨典校藝例當序
諸末簡迺進多士申告曰昔
孟軻氏應招大梁首舉仁義
對惠王而竟以不遇去今諸
生抱藝而至一旦錄名登之
===
===
天府行將用其言冀以遠大行業
視孟氏不為良遇耶顧諸生
夙所誦法者孟氏書也其引
觚吐詞而粹然淵然充有司
之目者則孟氏仁義之說也
操孟氏仁義之說以貢於有
司而遭遇過之不識異日者
punctuated:
河南鄉試錄後序

隆慶庚午秋八月，河南鄉試事竣。其以叨典校藝，例當序諸末簡，迺進多士申告曰：「昔孟軻氏應招大梁，首舉仁義對惠王，而竟以不遇去。今諸生抱藝而至，一旦錄名登之天府，行將用其言，冀以遠大行業，視孟氏不為良遇耶？顧諸生夙所誦法者，孟氏書也。其引觚吐詞，而粹然淵然充有司之目者，則孟氏仁義之說也。操孟氏仁義之說以貢於有司，而遭遇過之，不識異日者
translation_en:
Postface to the Record of the Henan Provincial Examination

In the eighth month of autumn in the gengwu year of Longqing [1570], the Henan Provincial Examination concluded. Having undeservedly been entrusted with evaluating the candidates’ compositions, I [?] was obliged by customary practice to append a postface to the final pages. I therefore called the assembled scholars forward and addressed them further:

“Formerly, Meng Ke [Mencius] answered a summons to Daliang. In his response to King Hui, he spoke first of benevolence and righteousness, yet ultimately departed without finding recognition. Now you students have arrived bearing your literary accomplishments; once your names are recorded and entered in the imperial archives, your words will soon be put to use, with hopes for lofty and far-reaching conduct and achievements. Compared with Master Meng’s experience, is this not a fortunate encounter?

“Yet what you students have long recited and taken as your model is Master Meng’s book. What you put forth when you take up your writing tablets—the pure and profound compositions that fill the examining officials’ gaze—is Master Meng’s teaching of benevolence and righteousness. You present Master Meng’s teaching of benevolence and righteousness to the officials, and the recognition you receive surpasses his. I wonder, in days to come …

title: 隆慶四年河南鄉試錄
text:
何以建之用而仰賛
聖天子明盛之理耶夫發揮聖謨
恢張王略而照耀簡冊者藝
也樹厥節志表世範俗或出
而當天下事奠
宗社靖疆圉以昭明于不朽者
行與業也行業脩矣藝絀焉
===
可也惟藝之工而行業卒鑿
則錄士者其何以有辭於天
下公輸氏採材於名山大壑
得參天干雲之榦矍然喜而
轉之洪河以歸謂是可棟而
梁也迨梓人登場操引而運
斤焉則蠹其中而腹若敗絮
punctuated:
何以建之用，而仰賛聖天子明盛之理耶？夫發揮聖謨、恢張王略而照耀簡冊者，藝也。樹厥節志，表世範俗，或出而當天下事，奠宗社，靖疆圉，以昭明于不朽者，行與業也。行業脩矣，藝絀焉，可也。惟藝之工，而行業卒鑿，則錄士者其何以有辭於天下？
公輸氏採材於名山大壑，得參天干雲之榦，矍然喜而轉之洪河以歸，謂是可棟而梁也。迨梓人登場，操引而運斤焉，則蠹其中而腹若敗絮。
translation_en:
…how will they put it to use and thereby assist the sage Son of Heaven’s enlightened and flourishing government? To expound the sage’s plans, extend the scope of royal strategy, and shine in the written records—these are achievements of literary accomplishment. To establish integrity and resolve, serve as an exemplar to the age and a model for its customs, or enter public service and shoulder the affairs of the realm, secure the imperial ancestral temples and altars of state, pacify the frontiers, and thereby win undying renown—these are matters of conduct and achievement. If conduct and achievement are cultivated, it is acceptable for literary accomplishment to fall short. But if literary accomplishment alone is polished while conduct and achievement prove altogether misguided [?], what justification can those who select scholars offer to the world?
Master Gongshu gathered timber in renowned mountains and deep ravines. Finding a trunk that towered into the heavens and reached the clouds, he rejoiced in astonishment and floated it home down a great river, saying that it could serve as a ridgepole or beam. But when the carpenter came to the worksite, took up his measuring cord [?], and wielded his axe, it proved worm-eaten within, its core like rotten floss.

title: 隆慶四年河南鄉試錄
text:
九方皐相馬于燕市也曰臣
力不加焉於中選其一二耳
乃御者駕之而橫犇絕轡卽
王造不之良矣梓人御者指
而讓公輸方皐公輸方皐各
諤諤瞪目相嚮以爲吾初採
而相者也詎謂有是耶士今
===
以藝進而有司亦以藝錄士
者竊恐其類是也夫二氏擅
天下之絕鑒者也而猶若此
今余之鑒謝二氏萬萬矣能
保諸生中無敗絮橫犇者哉
余誠願諸生以藝進者務端
其行業究王道仁義之用以
punctuated: 九方皐相馬于燕市也，曰：「臣力不加焉，於中選其一二耳。」乃御者駕之，而橫犇絕轡，卽王造不之良矣。梓人、御者指而讓公輸、方皐，公輸、方皐各諤諤瞪目相嚮，以爲：「吾初採而相者也，詎謂有是耶？」士今以藝進，而有司亦以藝錄士者，竊恐其類是也。夫二氏擅天下之絕鑒者也，而猶若此。今余之鑒謝二氏萬萬矣，能保諸生中無敗絮橫犇者哉？余誠願諸生以藝進者，務端其行業，究王道仁義之用，以
translation_en: Jiufang Gao appraised horses in the market of Yan, saying: “Your servant can do no more than select one or two from among them.” Yet when the charioteer harnessed them, they bolted wildly and broke their reins; even Wang Zao [?] would not consider them good horses. The carpenter and the charioteer pointed accusingly at Gongshu and Jiufang Gao. Gongshu and Jiufang Gao stared at each other in consternation, thinking: “These are what we originally selected and appraised. Who could have imagined this?” Scholars now advance through literary skill, and the responsible officials likewise select scholars on that basis. I fear that their case may resemble this. Those two men possessed unsurpassed discernment, yet even they met with such results. My discernment falls immeasurably short of theirs: can I guarantee that among you scholars there are none like rotten wadding or wildly bolting horses? I earnestly hope that those of you advancing through literary skill will strive to set your conduct and pursuits aright and thoroughly investigate the practical application of the kingly Way, benevolence, and righteousness, so as to…

title: 隆慶四年河南鄉試錄
text:
光孟氏未有之遭而俁錄士
者得脫于梓人御者之讓斯
幸矣不則不知之罪無赦雖
然士之于世也猶金之在冶
惟所鎔範也諸生生當
昌熈景運在
聖天子大冶鈞鎔中其爲紫磨之
===
金而不與礦石陶瓦埒也審
矣異日贊王道精金而致
明盛之理使天下嘖嘖稱得人
曰是大梁仁義士其庶乎不
辱良遇哉余故於諸生之始
進也期之行業因舉其平時
首所誦法者勗之
punctuated: 光孟氏未有之遭，而俁錄士者得脫于梓人、御者之讓，斯幸矣。不則不知之罪無赦。雖然，士之于世也，猶金之在冶，惟所鎔範也。諸生生當昌熈景運，在聖天子大冶鈞鎔中，其爲紫磨之金，而不與礦石、陶瓦埒也，審矣。異日贊王道精金而致明盛之理，使天下嘖嘖稱得人，曰：「是大梁仁義士。」其庶乎不辱良遇哉！余故於諸生之始進也，期之行業，因舉其平時首所誦法者勗之。
translation_en: …to bring glory to an opportunity such as even Master Meng never encountered, and allow [?] those who select scholars to escape the reproach incurred by the carpenter and the charioteer: that would indeed be fortunate. Otherwise, the fault of failing to recognize talent admits of no pardon. Nevertheless, scholars in the world are like metal in a furnace: they depend upon how they are cast and molded. You students were born into a splendid age of flourishing peace. Within the great furnace in which the sage Son of Heaven molds and refines, you will assuredly become gold of the finest purity, ranking far above ore and earthenware tiles. In days to come, may you assist the Kingly Way as refined gold [?] and bring about enlightened and flourishing government, so that all under Heaven will voice their admiration that worthy men have been found, saying, “These are the humane and righteous scholars of Daliang.” Would this not come close to doing justice to your fortunate opportunity? Thus, as you students first advance, I place my hopes in your conduct and endeavors, and encourage you by invoking what you have always foremost recited and taken as your model.

title: 隆慶四年河南鄉試錄
text:
直隸和州儒學學正何其中
謹序
punctuated: 直隸和州儒學學正何其中謹序。
translation_en: He Qizhong 何其中, Instructor at the Confucian School of Hezhou in Zhili, respectfully composed this preface.
